materials.title: At the bakery
materials.text:
Choose the best reply in each conversation.

1. Child: Is this bread for sale?
Baker: ____

2. Baker: Which cake would you like?
Child: ____

3. Child: May I have a bag for the bread?
Baker: ____

4. Baker: The cake is for later. Can you carry the box flat?
Child: ____

5. Child: This is the wrong bag. Mine has a cake inside.
Baker: ____

questions.prompt:
Child: Is this bread for sale?
Baker: ____
questions.explanation: Yes plus a price confirms the sale. Age, time and door count do not answer whether bread can be bought.

questions.prompt:
Baker: Which cake would you like?
Child: ____
questions.explanation: The little round one selects a cake. Location, ability and family identity do not choose an item.

questions.prompt:
Child: May I have a bag for the bread?
Baker: ____
questions.explanation: Providing a bag grants the request. Another person’s location, wet shoes and identifying a bird do not.

questions.prompt:
Baker: The cake is for later. Can you carry the box flat?
Child: ____
options: Yes. I will hold it with both hands.
questions.explanation: Holding the box with both hands responds to carrying it flat. Day, introduction and preference do not confirm the action.

questions.prompt:
Child: This is the wrong bag. Mine has a cake inside.
Baker: ____
options: Sorry. Let me check the bags.
questions.explanation: Checking the bags addresses the mistaken purchase. Weather, a bus and sister identity do not correct it.

units.title: Two different socks
units.instruction: 读完整材料，判断句子是否相符。

materials.title: Two different socks
materials.text:
It is Friday. The children can wear funny socks to school today. Eva puts on one red sock and one yellow sock. Her brother Max laughs. "Your socks are different!" he says.

"I know," says Eva. "Look at the school note."

Max reads it. Then he takes off his two blue socks. He puts on one blue sock and one green sock instead.

At school, their teacher has socks with cats on them. Eva's friend has long purple socks. The children look at all the colours before they sit down for their first lesson.

questions.prompt: It is funny-sock day at school.
questions.explanation: The note allows funny socks on Friday.

questions.prompt: Eva wears two red socks.
questions.explanation: She wears one red and one yellow.

questions.prompt: Max reads the school note.
questions.explanation: Eva points it out and Max reads it.

questions.prompt: Max wears two blue socks to school.
questions.explanation: He changes to one blue and one green before school.

questions.prompt: The teacher’s socks have cats on them.
questions.explanation: The teacher’s socks show cats.

units.title: A message for Grandma
units.instruction: 读完整材料，判断句子是否相符。

materials.title: A message for Grandma
materials.text:
Noah wants to tell Grandma about his school garden. He draws a tomato plant on a card. The tomatoes in his picture are red and yellow.

Mum asks, "Do you want to write a message too?" Noah writes, "We have six plants. I water them on Monday."

Grandma lives nearby, so they walk to her house after school. She puts the card on her fridge. Then she shows Noah a small plant on her kitchen window. It has green tomatoes. "Mine are not ready yet," she says. Noah wants to come back and see them when they are red.

questions.prompt: Noah draws a plant on the card.
questions.explanation: He draws a tomato plant.

questions.prompt: The tomatoes in his picture are all green.
questions.explanation: His drawn tomatoes are red and yellow; Grandma’s actual tomatoes are green.

questions.prompt: Noah waters the school plants on Monday.
questions.explanation: His written message gives Monday.

questions.prompt: They travel to Grandma’s house by train.
questions.explanation: She lives nearby and they walk.

questions.prompt: Grandma puts the card in a cupboard.
questions.explanation: She puts it on the fridge.

units.title: The blanket on the chair
units.instruction: 读完整材料，判断句子是否相符。

materials.title: The blanket on the chair
materials.text:
Mum puts a small blanket on the chair for our cat Dot. The blanket is soft and blue. Dot looks at it, then jumps into an empty paper box on the floor.

I put the blanket inside the box. Dot walks around it and gets in. Soon she is asleep.

My brother wants to use the box for his toy cars. I show him Dot. "She is sleeping here now," I say.

He finds another box beside the desk. He puts his cars in that one. Dot stays in her warm box, with her tail over her nose.

questions.prompt: Dot is a dog.
questions.explanation: Dot is the family’s cat.

questions.prompt: The blanket is soft and blue.
questions.explanation: Both qualities are stated.

questions.prompt: Dot first chooses the box on the floor.
questions.explanation: She jumps into it instead of onto the prepared chair.

questions.prompt: The brother wakes Dot and takes her box.
questions.explanation: He chooses another box rather than disturbing her.

questions.prompt: Dot sleeps with her tail over her nose.
questions.explanation: The final sentence gives that position.

materials.title: The shoe in the bucket
materials.text:
Luca goes to the beach with his parents. He takes off his shoes and puts them beside Dad's bag. Then he and Mum build a sandcastle.

Dad fills a yellow bucket with water. When he brings it back, he sees one small shoe near the water. He picks it up and puts it in the empty blue bucket.

Later, Luca looks for his shoes. One is beside the bag, but the other is missing. Dad shows him the blue bucket. The shoe is sandy but dry. Luca shakes out the sand and puts both shoes on before they leave.

questions.prompt: Luca goes to the beach alone.
questions.explanation: He is with his parents.

questions.prompt: Luca builds a sandcastle with Mum.
questions.explanation: They build it together.

questions.prompt: Dad uses a yellow bucket for water.
questions.explanation: The yellow bucket is filled with water.

questions.prompt: Dad puts the shoe in the water bucket.
questions.explanation: He uses the separate empty blue bucket.

questions.prompt: Luca puts his shoes on before leaving.
questions.explanation: He removes the sand and puts both on.

materials.title: The class photograph
materials.text:
Tara brings a class photograph home in a big envelope. She puts it on the kitchen table. Her little sister wants to see it too.

"Where are you?" asks her sister. Tara points to the back row. She is beside a boy with glasses. Their teacher is in the middle of the front row.

Dad finds a frame in a cupboard. It is too small for the photograph. Mum finds a bigger one in the living room. The picture fits this frame.

They put it on Tara's desk. Her sister can look at it, but Tara asks her to leave the glass clean.

questions.prompt: Tara carries the photograph in an envelope.
questions.explanation: The envelope is large.

questions.prompt: Tara is in the front row.
questions.explanation: She is in the back row.

questions.prompt: The teacher is in the middle of the front row.
questions.explanation: That position is stated.

questions.prompt: Dad’s first frame is too big.
questions.explanation: It is too small; Mum finds a larger one.

questions.prompt: The framed photograph goes on Tara’s desk.
questions.explanation: They place it there.
